claims.claim: Bunge's expanded post-Viterra platform is showing higher processing and merchandising volumes across multiple regions, strengthening its ability to route agricultural flows amid shifting trade patterns.

risks.risk: Commodity processing economics remain exposed to crush margins, crop conditions, policy and trade-flow volatility.

unknowns.unknown: Durable synergy capture and normalized post-integration returns on the expanded asset base remain to be demonstrated over multiple cycles.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 adjusted EPS rose to $2.00 from $1.31, Bunge completed the $2 billion Viterra-related repurchase program, and management raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $9.25-$9.75 from $9.00-$9.50.

risks.risk: Raised guidance still depends on forward commodity curves and margin conditions; Corporate and Other costs were higher year over year.

unknowns.unknown: Full-year integration costs, leverage trajectory and realized synergies require continued monitoring.
